Record Class DaoKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
iu.dao.DaoKey
Record Components:
type - cached entity type
parameters - key values the read was performed with
maxResults - row cap the read was performed with, or LOAD for a single-entity load
record DaoKey(Class<?> type, Map<String,?> parameters, int maxResults) extends Record
Identifies one cached read in the process-wide read cache.

The parameter map is copied and wrapped on construction so that a caller mutating the map it passed to a search cannot corrupt the key's hash code after the entry has been stored.

maxResults participates in equality because a capped search and an uncapped one over the same parameters are different results. A single-entity load uses LOAD, so its entries can never collide with a search, and so a search is able to publish the rows it read as loads of their own.
